messages:
Jess: Proposal: 'Lab Night: Serving Decisions in Practice' webinar. Tight format: 60m total — 10m framing, 35m guided labs (attendees pick a lane), 15m capstone demos. Goal: show live tradeoffs (latency vs cost vs quality). Thoughts?

Leah: love it. capture lane + infra interest in the signup form so we can route folks to the right nurture track.

Sanju: infra constraints: ephemeral sandboxes with token quotas required. I'll provide a small script and a staging pool. Recommend token_quota=3000 and ttl=60m.

Sanju: example CLI:
```bash
redwoodctl sandbox create --model redwood-13b-q4 --ttl 60m --token-quota 3000 --label lab-night-2026
```

Oliver: plan a 2min prerecorded failover demo (switch to hosted tiny model) in case sandboxes saturate. keeps the experience smooth.

Matt: rehearsal plan: single 30m run-through for flow + 15m tech check day-before. avoid extra dress rehearsals.

Elaine: timeline: blurb by Wed, speakers confirmed Fri, infra checklist Mon, prerecord failover by Thu.

Jess: speakers: quick intro (me), infra clinic (Sanju), customer mini-case (5m), Matt to moderate capstone. I'll reach out to two customers for 1x "metrics snapshot" slot.

Leah: I'll build the lead form and HubSpot mapping. post-event micro-survey (1 Q) about which config they preferred.

deploy-bot: Notice: maintenance window on inference-dedicated-pool 2026-05-02 02:00-02:30 UTC. Avoid scheduling conflicts.

Jess: owners: I'll own speaker outreach and abstracts.

Sanju: I'll own sandbox provisioning and quotas.

Leah: I'll own lead capture & routing.

Oliver: I'll produce the failover clip.

Matt: I'll run the tech rehearsals and moderate.

Elaine: I'll assemble the ops checklist and attendee email. Thanks everyone :rocket:
